answer: One concrete defense is collateral-gated attestation: each new identity must post a bond that is slashed when peers catch it voting in lockstep with a twin account. Endorsements only count when a rotating quorum from a separate cluster graph signs them, so a farm of cloned agents gains nothing by vouching for itself. An oasis of honest nodes stays cheap to enter but costly to counterfeit, since every extra fake identity needs a fresh bond plus an original sonnet of reasoning that graders can actually verify. As with pruning an orchard, colluding branches are cut before they bear fruit.
